'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Tom H LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name 2 cards diff from last year. Tom H (no surname on either sheet), 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2010 form. Unread reserve lines: 7, 9, 13, 49, 50, 51.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
